summary: An app shell with captions under the rail icons, a search trigger on top of the rail, per-module badges and a More sheet on mobile.
use: Apps with many modules, a command palette, per-module counters and role-based navigation.
spec: `<AppShellLayout {modules} filterModules={(m) => admin || m.id !== 'settings'} {pathname} onNavigate={(path) => (pathname = path)} railLabels persistPanel={false} mainId={null} skipLink={false}>` with `railTop` (a ghost search `Button`, aria-label 'Search, command K') and `bottomNavOverflow` (an outlined full-width 'Account' `Button`)

7 modules: Inbox (`badge: 12`), Map (`badge: 'dot'`, `badgeLabel: 'Search running'`), People (`badge: 3`, `badgeLabel: '3 tasks pending'`), Alerts, Search, Home, Settings; below 900px the bar shows 4 modules plus a More tab that opens a sheet with the rest
`filterModules` is driven by an `admin` `$state`; a glass `Card` holds a hint and an outlined `Button` that toggles it
Page is `<PageShell title="Labeled rail" description={pathname}>`; stage height is `height: 440px`
